entries.german:
Martin (von Toužim), Profeßpriester des Stiftes Mühlhausen, erklärt sich vor dem Landeshauptmann Reinprecht von Wallsee bereit, die Propstei Schlägl für ein oder zwei Jahre zu übernehmen; dies bestätigt der Notar Andreas Guldein.

"In nomine Domini. Amen. Anno ab incarnacione Domini millesimo quadringentesimo octauo, indiccione prima, die vero quinta mensis junij, hora completorii uel quasi, pontificatu sanctissimi in Christo patris et domini, domini nostri Gregorij(1), diuina prouidencia pape duodecimi, anno suo suo [!] secundo, jn mei notarii publici testiumque infra scriptorum presencia personaliter constitutus. Ego, Martinus(2), professus monasterii Milocensis, Pragensis diocesis, de gracia Dei prepositus in Plaga, Patauiensis diocesis, quam preposituram ego, prefatus Martinus, obtinui per tres sentencias diffinitivas, vbi tunc temporis curia Romana residebat, ego antedictus Martinus obligaui me coram nobili domino, domino Reinberto de Walssee(3) et coram notario publico infrascripto omnia infrascripta rata, firma et grata tenere ac habere, et ad id non coactus, non conpulsus verbis neque factis nec vllo quovis alio modo. Ego, Martinus sepedictus, debeo et volo omnnes meas litteras apostolicas bullatas cum processibus et tribus sentencijs diffinitiuis obtenta ac omnia mea monumenta siue instrumenta resignare et ad repositorium ponere nobilissimi domini Reinberti de Walssee, et prefatam preposituram debeo ad vnum uel duos annos regere et vti cum fructibus, redditibus, iuribus et obuencionibus, sicut et ego me obligaui in vna littera sigillata(4) in thewtunico composita, scripta et roborata cum octo sigillis appensa et specialiter sigillis venerabilis domini, domini Swamitomiri(5), abbatis monasterii Milacensis ac magnifici domini Heinrici de Rosenberg(6) et aliorum discretorum virorum sigilla appendencium. Super quibus ita gestis et factis sepe dictus Martinus pecijt ita fieri per me, notarium publicum infrascriptum, vnum uel plura instrumentum uel instrumenta tociens, quociens necessarium aut oportunum fuerit. Acta sunt hec jn castro Lincze(7), Patauiensis diocesis, anno, jndiccione, die, loco et hora, pontificatu, quibus supra, presentibus honorabilibus ac nobilibus viris et dominis, domino Walthero strenuo milite de Sewsenekk(8), Petro Anhanger(9), Johanne Harrocher(10) purgrafio tunc temporis in Rosenberg, laicis Patauiensis diocesis nec non pluribus fide dignis testibus ad premissa vocatis pariter et rogatis in testimonium omnium premissorum etc. etc." [NOTARIATSSIGNET] "Et ego, Andreas dictus Guldein(11), clericus Patauiensis, publicus apostolica et jmperiali auctoritate notarius, dicte compromissioni, arbitracioni ac omnibus alijs et singulis dum sic, ut premittitur, fierent et agerentur vnacum prenominatis testibus presens interfui eaque sic fieri et audiui prefatum Martinum ad illa non coactum, illa in hanc publicam formam redegi, propria manu mea scripsi signoque nomine meis solitis signaui et requisitus in euidens testimonium omnium premissorum etc. etc. etc."
entries.english:
Martin (von Toužim), a professed priest of the monastery of Mühlhausen, declares before the provincial governor Reinprecht von Wallsee that he is willing to take over the provostship of Schlägl for one or two years; the notary Andreas Guldein confirms this.

"In the name of the Lord. Amen. In the year 1408 from the Incarnation of the Lord, the first indiction, on the fifth day of June, at or about the hour of Compline, in the pontificate of the most holy father and lord in Christ, our lord Pope Gregory XII, by divine providence, in his second year, there personally appeared before me, the public notary, in the presence of the witnesses written below, I, Martin, professed of the monastery of Mühlhausen, in the diocese of Prague, by the grace of God provost in Plaga, in the diocese of Passau. I obtained that provostship through three definitive sentences, where the Roman Curia then resided. I, the aforesaid Martin, obligated myself before the noble lord Reinprecht von Wallsee and before the public notary written below to hold all the matters set out below as ratified, firm and approved; I was not compelled or coerced to this by word, deed or in any other way. I, the aforesaid Martin, must and will surrender all my apostolic letters bearing bulls, together with the proceedings and the three definitive sentences obtained, and all my records or instruments, and place them in the repository of the most noble lord Reinprecht von Wallsee. I must govern and administer the aforesaid provostship for one or two years, with its fruits, revenues, rights and income, as I also obligated myself in a sealed letter written and authenticated in German, to which eight seals were attached, especially those of the venerable lord Swamitomir, abbot of the monastery of Mühlhausen, and the illustrious lord Heinrich von Rosenberg, as well as the seals of other prudent men who affixed their seals. Concerning these acts and deeds, the aforesaid Martin requested that I, the public notary written below, draw up one or more instruments as often as necessary or useful. These things were done in the castle of Linz, in the diocese of Passau, in the year, indiction, day, place, hour and pontificate stated above, in the presence of the honorable and noble men and lords Walter, valiant knight of Seusenegg, Peter Anhanger, and Johann Harrocher, at that time Burgrave at Rosenberg, laymen of the diocese of Passau, as well as several trustworthy witnesses summoned and requested together for the foregoing, in testimony of all the foregoing, etc. etc." [NOTARIAL SIGN] "And I, Andreas called Guldein, cleric of Passau and public notary by apostolic and imperial authority, was present with the named witnesses at the aforesaid agreement, arbitration and all the other matters, each and every one, as they were done and conducted in the manner stated above; I heard them done in this way, and heard the aforesaid Martin declare that he was not compelled to them. I drew them up in this public form, wrote them in my own hand and signed them with my customary sign and name; when requested, as evident testimony to all the foregoing, etc. etc. etc."
